question: An airplane travels a specific distance at a speed of 240 km/h over the course of 5 hours. To cover the same distance in just 1 hour, it needs to fly at a speed of:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When distance is constant, speed is inversely proportional to time.

Time ratio = 5 : 1

Speed ratio = 1 : 5

Given 1 unit of speed = 240 km/h

Required speed = 5 units = 5 × 240 = 1200 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 1200 km/h.**
